niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, geography, creative needs and whether you want full‑service media buying or a tech/creative specialist. To help you pick, here’s a short, practical guide.

Quick questions so I can recommend specific agencies for your situation
- Are you a brand or direct‑response advertiser?
- Primary objective: awareness/brand building or performance/ROAS?
- Monthly CTV budget (ballpark)?
- Region(s) you want to target (US, EMEA, APAC)?
- Need creative production/ad‑versioning, or only media buying/measurement?

Well‑known/commonly recommended options and what they’re good at
- Global full‑service media holding groups (large scale, cross‑channel integration)
  - GroupM (WPP), Omnicom Media Group (OMD/PHD), Publicis Media (Starcom/Zenith), Dentsu (Carat/Xaxis), IPG
  - Best if you need global reach, programmatic scale, and integrated TV+digital planning.

- Performance/data‑driven specialists
  - The Trade Desk (DSP — not an agency, but central to many programmatic CTV buys), VideoAmp (measurement & planning), Cadent
  - Best if you want tightly measured, targeted programmatic campaigns.

- CTV creative/ad‑tech specialists
  - Innovid (creative/ad serving/measurement), Tremor/Exponential, Magnite/SpotX (SSP)
  - Best if you need dynamic/ad‑personalized creative and in‑stream ad tech.

- Boutique/specialist agencies
  - Tinuiti, VaynerMedia, MNTN (performance CTV specialist), Simulmedia
  - Best if you want hands‑on service, performance optimization and creative tailored to CTV.

How to decide (evaluation checklist)
- Clear KPIs: brand lift vs conversions vs app installs
- Inventory & targeting: linear‑replacement, addressable, platform (Roku/Hulu/CTV apps)
- Measurement: third‑party brand lift, viewability, deterministic/identity solutions
- Creative capabilities: 16:9 vs interactive CTV, dynamic creative, frequency capping
- Transparency & fees: media markup, tech fees, data access
- Case studies in your vertical and references
- Campaign piloting: start with a test & measurable metrics

Questions to ask any prospective agency
- Which CTV platforms and SSPs do you buy on?
- How do you measure incrementality and viewability?
- Can you show vendor/partner costs and a typical fee structure?
- Do you produce/adapt creative for CTV? How many versions?
- Can you run a small pilot and what KPIs will you use?

If you tell me your objectives, budget and target region I’ll recommend 3 agencies (or tech partners) that best match your needs and why.
